build_sam_vit_b: build a SAM ViT-B image encoder with configurable output channels and optional checkpoint loading
build_clip_l: build a CLIP vision model with 24 transformer layers and 1024 hidden size for image embeddings
build_qwen2_decoder_as_encoder: build a Qwen2 decoder-as-encoder that transforms vision tokens using query embeddings and causal masking
create_MlpProjector: create an MLP projector with configurable type, depth, and downsample ratio to project vision features to text embedding space
merge_multimodal_embeddings: merge multimodal embeddings into input embeddings by overwriting placeholder token positions in input_ids
